hero.sub: Alu Studio makes four apps for iPhone, iPad and Android: a point of sale for small shops, a notebook for the people you love, a postcard tracker for Pikmin Bloom, and daily play ideas for young kids.
hero.proof: On the App Store and Google Play

apps.heading: Four apps, each built for one job
apps.sub: Every app has its own site with guides, FAQ and support.

pikgeon.desc: Scan your Pikmin Bloom postcards and track every mailing journey. Recognition runs on your phone, so your postcards stay private.

babbby.tagline: Daily activity ideas for ages 0 to 6
babbby.desc: Track milestones, build routines, and pick from 340+ activities matched to your child's age.

sotto.desc: What they love, what they can't stand, the little things that make them smile. Kept close, because caring is remembering.

dingpos.desc: Open your store in 10 minutes. A point of sale that keeps working offline, with your sales data kept on your iPad.

tagline: Software for the small moments: a sale at the counter, a friend's birthday, a postcard from far away, an afternoon of play.

items.title: One app, one job
items.body: Each app is built around a single task, so the screen you need is the one you see first.

items.title: Your records stay on your device
items.body: DingPOS, Sotto and Pikgeon store what you enter on your own phone or iPad. None of it is sent to our servers.

items.title: Questions reach the maker
items.body: Write to the studio and the person who built the app replies.

contact.heading: Questions about an app?
contact.sub: Every app has its own support page and FAQ. For anything else, write to the studio.

sotto.name: Mia Chen
sotto.new_note: Wants to see Kyoto in spring
